records.text: :tada: New signup: *Lantern Works* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:79d826f0, email:f8bdc91c) or tickets — no signal of engagement. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance of a self-serve start, but silence makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand getting Lantern Works started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Checking in once more since I haven't heard back — no problem if the first week got busy.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first project is the natural starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'll walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
